answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation, company blog and party statement, 2026-07-01 (incoming).
answer.note: NVIDIA says it is introducing a model through which AI clouds can procure NVIDIA infrastructure using revenue sharing and credit support, sell NVIDIA-powered services, and provide NVIDIA both standard product revenue and a share of cloud revenue on supported capacity (incoming). This supports a potential additional, usage-linked revenue stream alongside product sales and a mechanism intended to expand access to NVIDIA compute; it does not establish realized revenue or orders. NVIDIA describes AI cloud companies as building DSX AI factories (item:e3). Sharon AI’s CEO described a strategic collaboration with NVIDIA, while NVIDIA says Firmus is building a DSX campus in Batam expected to scale to 360 MW and up to 170,000 NVIDIA GPUs (item:e2; item:e4). These are project and capacity leads relevant to potential infrastructure demand, not proof of NVIDIA sales, deployed capacity, or a direct purchase by either company. NVIDIA also points to AI-native companies’ need for capacity, which is sector demand context rather than disclosed orders (incoming). If the model is adopted and supported capacity is deployed and used, it could contribute product sales and recurring revenue share; the article does not quantify that contribution.
limitations: The article does not disclose the revenue-share formula, credit-support terms, counterparties’ obligations, or the status and scope of agreements under the model.
It gives no NVIDIA revenue, order, deployment, or utilization figures attributable to the model or the named projects.
Firmus’s 360 MW and up to 170,000 GPU figures are stated as expected scale; the article does not give a completion schedule, procurement status, or financing and operating details.
follow_up: Check NVIDIA filings and later company statements for agreements, recognized product revenue, revenue-share income, or credit exposure attributable to this model.
Check NVIDIA, Sharon AI, and Firmus announcements for the scope and status of their collaborations, any identified procurement, and project deployment milestones.
Track Firmus project updates for financing, construction, power availability, installed GPUs, and operating capacity against the stated expected scale.
